title: Virgo, 500 CFA francs, Zodiac signs
descriptionPlain: Description Virgo is an Earth sign, admired for its precision, practicality, and attention to detail. People born under this sign are known for their analytical minds, reliability, and willingness to help others. The silver coin featuring Virgo is a tribute to those who value harmony, modesty, and the beauty found in simplicity, while its presence in a collection reminds one of the strength of calm and consistency.
